stem_book: Ball I is thrown towards a tower at an angle of 60° with the horizontal with unknown speed (u). At the same moment, ball II is released from the top of the tower as shown in the figure. Balls collide after 2 s and at the moment of collision, the velocity of ball I is horizontal. Find the (i) speed u, (ii) distance of point of projection of ball I from base of tower (x), (iii) height of tower. (g = 10 m/s²)
reason: Three-part question with separate answers (key itself is correct).
